# SEO

## Purpose and boundaries

Inspect delivered main-document evidence together with route metadata source. A helper's presence is not proof of correct output on every page.

## Investigation sequence

Compare home, PLP, and PDP delivered metadata, then trace each value to source.

## Evidence and redaction

Cite delivered element/value and source line when available.

## Severity and blind spots

Crawler behavior and production indexing controls may vary by deployment.
